//: Declarative source of truth for the Flight definition, published through the MotherDuck API/MCP -- see README.md in this directory for the field-to-file mapping and how to publish it. Not a directory MotherDuck reads directly.
name: kbo-open-data-refresh
//schedule_cron: Left unset (on-demand only) until the KBO daily file's publication time is confirmed. See the cron caveat in README.md before setting this to a real schedule.
//flight_secret_names: The name of the MotherDuck secret, not of its parameters. Secret `kbo_sftp` with parameters KBO_SFTP_HOST, KBO_SFTP_USER and KBO_SFTP_PASSWORD is injected as kbo_sftp_KBO_SFTP_HOST and so on, which is what main.py reads.
